notes: Evals for the wave-based review pipeline used by /pr-review (GitHub mode) and /auto-review (local mode). Assertions are intentionally unset — fill them when running the first iteration through skill-creator's benchmark loop. See skill-creator/references/schemas.md for the full assertions shape.

evals.name: gh-small-pr-happy-path
evals.setup: Pick or craft a small open PR (≤5 files, ≤100 lines changed) with at least one real bug (e.g., off-by-one, missing await, or a subjective style issue). Prefer a throwaway repo so the pending review can be deleted without noise.
evals.expected_output: A PENDING review appears in the GitHub UI. Body contains the Review Guide (Contexto de negócio, Decisões, Onde focar, Mudanças incidentais — sections present only when they add value). Inline comments anchor on the right lines and carry the '— gerado por IA, revisado pelo usuário' signature footer, and every comment body passes the doc-standards density check. Token summary printed to terminal.

evals.name: gh-already-reviewed-early-exit
evals.setup: Re-run /pr-review on a PR that already carries the '— gerado por IA, revisado pelo usuário' signature from a prior pending review. Wave 0 should abort before launching specialists.
evals.expected_output: Skill prints 'abort: prior review detected'. No specialist Agent calls are made. Token total reflects only the Wave 0 PR-comments lookup.

evals.name: local-auto-review-with-incidental-changes
evals.setup: Create a throwaway feature branch with (a) one real bug in use-case code, (b) one subjective style quirk, (c) one incidental fix in an unrelated module (bump log level, fix typo). Run /auto-review main.
evals.expected_output: ./auto-review.md generated. Review Guide's 'Incidental changes' section lists the unrelated change and explains why it's incidental. The bug is flagged MANDATORY. The style quirk is flagged NITPICK with the subjective-opinion prefix. Token total printed at the bottom.
